name: cache-tax
description: Counts down to prompt-cache expiry while you are idle, estimates what a lapsed cache costs to reload, and adds /keepwarm for opt-in keep-alive pings.

ttl.title: Prompt cache TTL
ttl.description: The cache lifetime your account's requests use. Check your plan or API settings; Claude Code cloud sessions on claude.ai use 1h.

inputUsdPerMTok.title: Input price (USD per million tokens)
inputUsdPerMTok.description: Base input price of your main model. 0 shows token counts only.

warnMinutes.title: Warn this many minutes before expiry
warnMinutes.description: 0 uses 10 minutes for a 1h cache and 2 minutes for a 5m cache.
